messages.text: This is the Statue of the Hero. I come here every day to pray.
messages.raw: §fThis is the §9Statue of the Hero§f. I come here every day to pray.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 这是英雄雕像。我每天都会来这里祈祷。

segments.text: . I come here every day to pray.

messages.text: The legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.
messages.raw: §fThe legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 传说几百年前,有一位英雄来到这里,在危难中向我们伸出了援手。

messages.text: Some of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.
messages.raw: §fSome of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 我们当中,仍有人相信那位英雄终有一天会回来。

messages.text: Do you want me to tell the story?
messages.raw: §fDo you want me to tell the story?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 想听我讲讲这段故事吗?

messages.text: I could tell you were not very interested.
messages.raw: §fI could tell you were not very interested.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 看得出来,你不太感兴趣。

messages.text: I will go back to my prayers.
messages.raw: §fI will go back to my prayers.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 那我接着祈祷了。

messages.text: There are three different beliefs among the Taika.
messages.raw: §fThere are three different beliefs among the §aTaika§f.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: Taika 人有三种不同的信仰。

messages.text: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the Cathedral.
messages.raw: §fAfter we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the §5Cathedral§f.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 几百年前,我们开始研习魔法。从那以后,大多数人就不再去大教堂祈祷了。

segments.text: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the
segments.zh: 几百年前,我们开始研习魔法。从那以后,大多数人就不再去

messages.text: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the Cathedral into an Academy.
messages.raw: §fThey were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the §5Cathedral §finto an Academy.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 他们忙着学习、创造新法术,甚至把大教堂改成了学院。

segments.text: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the

messages.text: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
messages.raw: §fThose people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 他们会说,自己信仰的是知识与魔法。

messages.text: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
messages.raw: §fSome others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 也有人始终相信,正是祈祷赐予了我们力量。

messages.text: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through Sulphur, and that the Sky is good and fair.
messages.raw: §fThey believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through §aSulphur§f, and that the Sky is good and fair.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 他们相信,上天让我们借助硫磺自立,是早有安排的。他们也相信,上天仁慈而公正。

segments.text: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through
segments.zh: 他们相信,上天让我们借助

segments.text: , and that the Sky is good and fair.
segments.zh: 自立,是早有安排的。他们也相信,上天仁慈而公正。

messages.text: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the Hero.
messages.raw: §fAnd finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the §9Hero§f.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 最后,还有像我这样的少数人,依然信仰着那位英雄。

segments.text: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the
segments.zh: 最后,还有像我这样的少数人,依然信仰着那位

messages.text: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
messages.raw: §fThe Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 那位英雄谦逊无名,却将我们所有人从毁灭中拯救了出来。

messages.text: I must pray at home, for it is late.
messages.raw: §fI must pray at home, for it is late.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 天色晚了,我得回家祈祷。

messages.text: The town may never sleep, but I do.
messages.raw: §fThe town may never sleep, but I do.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 城镇或许不眠,我可得睡觉。

messages.text: Rise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!
messages.raw: §fRise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 打起精神来! 从黄昏祈祷到黎明!

messages.text: Are you coming to pray with me?
messages.raw: §fAre you coming to pray with me?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 你要来和我一起祈祷吗?

messages.text: I'm trying to sleep.
messages.raw: §fI'm trying to sleep.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 我正要睡觉呢。

messages.context: Edelis: [NPC] Edelis: It is very late.
messages.text: It is very late.
messages.raw: §fIt is very late.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 已经很晚了。

messages.text: What do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?
messages.raw: §fWhat do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 你怎么看? 你也相信那位英雄吗?

messages.context: Edelis: [NPC] Edelis: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
messages.text: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
messages.raw: §fDo you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 完整对话表（无 Dialogue 标题）；颜色来自渲染 DOM。
messages.zh: 你觉得那位英雄是男是女? 留下来的记载实在太少了……
